name: ClauseHarbor
summary: A fictional first-pass review desk for contracts. It is sample data, not a product you can buy.
paragraphs: ClauseHarbor, in this sample, reads a contract and marks missing clauses, odd dates, and defined terms that never get used. It is built here so the directory has a page shape. There is no company by this name behind the listing.
A real listing in this slot would say what the tool actually does, who it is for, and what it costs. This page shows the fields. It does not describe a live service.
whyItMatters: A practice would only keep a tool like this if a lawyer's check of closed files got shorter, and the saved time covered the subscription more than once.
pricing: Sample pricing, not a live offer.
bestFor: A small practice that wants to see the directory format, not a vendor to call.
